content: {"episode_id":"ep-05051","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 based on the documented clinical indication. The patient has recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for supraventricular tachycardia and sick sinus syndrome. Given the recent history of a transient cerebral ischemic attack, the clinical indication note states that continuous ambulatory monitoring is required to correlate potential arrhythmic events with neurological symptoms and guide further management."}
